title: Querying a large Notion data source stops at 10,000 rows with has_more false
symptoms: Sync copies exactly 10,000 rows from a larger data source and reports success
cause: A single data source query pages through at most 10,000 results. At the cap has_more turns false and the response is only flagged incomplete, so a normal pagination loop ends quietly.
fix: Check request_status on every response, and split the read into windows (for example by created_time) that each stay under the cap. The JS SDK ships a helper that does this.
affected: Notion data source query endpoint as documented 2026-10; helper in @notionhq/client 5.27.0
